title: The Funniest Pup
lines: Mina and Sam went to see six pups.
The pups sat in a big box by the door.
Five pups ran up to the side of the box.
They licked and jumped and made a fuss.
But the tan pup hid in a red hat.
Only its nose and one paw stuck out.
"That is the funniest pup," said Mina.
"That one is hiding from us," said Sam.
Mina tried to lift it out of the hat.
The pup cried and held on tight.
Mina set it back down and sat still.
She did not want to make it cry again.
Then Sam held up a bit of meat.
The pup stuck one paw out. Then two.
Out it came, right into Mina's lap.
It licked her chin and did not cry.
It was now the happiest pup of all.
Mina said, "This is the one for us."
Sam carried the red hat home too.
The pup went to sleep in it that night.

questions.ask: Where did the tan pup hide?
questions.listenFor: In a red hat. Have them find the line and point at it.

questions.ask: What did Mina try first, and did it work?
questions.listenFor: She tried to lift the pup out. It did not work - the pup cried and held on tight.

questions.ask: Do you think that pup was really the funniest? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer. What you want is a reason - hiding in a hat is the one in the story.
